feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **R5 worktree harness + clarity + smoke exit reconcile**
feature_release_facing.assertion: `goal` 启动后在 run 目录生成 `intent-capture.json`（含 verbatim `utterance`）与 `intent-contract.json`。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **R6/R7 truth_freeze_gate + AC-063 reconcile + generate frozen gate**
feature_release_facing.assertion: 相同 utterance + rules_hash 两次分类产出相同 `intent_class`、`scope_mode`；`rules_hash` 与 classifier 版本一致。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **Parent failure backoff（继承 parent）**：`implement_loop` 复用 parent orchestrator AC-019：agent-reported failure 立即下一轮；retryable hard error 指数退避；连续失败达上限 abort；no-op iteration 计为 failure。
feature_release_facing.assertion: `delivery`/`review-only` 写入 `review-artifact.json`，含 `intent_snapshot`、`scope_mode`、`findings`、`runtime_evidence_only=true`、`formal_verdict_authority=false`。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **Beacon phase prompt**：每轮 iteration prompt 注入当前 Beacon 阶段、allowed/forbidden harness 命令、Skills 职责摘要（非 subprocess 读 MD）；落盘 `beacon-phase.json` + prompt 正文。
feature_release_facing.assertion: resolve blocked 时进入 `truth_fill`，`truth-promotion.json` 记录 beacon CLI 序列；无 accepted defer 时不写入 implicit mvp scope。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **全迭代 agent backend**：truth/generate/repair 阶段均通过 agent adapter 执行；不得仅 implement 单层调 codex。
feature_release_facing.assertion: truth 未 frozen 时 `delivery-state` 不得进入 `implement_loop`；`execute-only` 无 `--feature` 或 resolve fail 时 blocked。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **非模板 truth 默认**：冷启动默认走 agent truth phase；`prd-bootstrap` 模板链仅 `--truth-bootstrap=fallback`；drill utterance 须产出含 OSS/parity 信号的 research 而非纯脚手架 AC。
feature_release_facing.assertion: `--mode delivery` 依次 invoke import/qa/release stubs；payload 含 `closure_verdict=not_provided_by_beacon_loop` 与 beacon verdict refs。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **Harness 阶段检查点**：迭代间强制可记账 harness 调用（resolve/freeze/qa/release）；`truth-promotion.json` 含 phase + command + exit_code。
feature_release_facing.assertion: qa fail fixture 触发 `repair_from_qa` → `implement_loop`；`notes.md` 含 qa finding 摘要；cap 后停止。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **beacon-loop 降级**：`packages/beacon-loop` 冻结为 R3 参考；新 AC 实现于 `beacon-run`；`beacon-loop goal` 可委托 beacon-run（deprecated 文档化）。
feature_release_facing.assertion: `delivery-state.json` 状态转移符合 truth State Model；非法转移测试失败；`resume` 从 `repair_from_qa`/`user_decision_pending` 恢复。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **Core CLI 契约对齐**：`beacon implement run` 支持 `--output-schema`（与 AC-045 一致）；branch/dirty preflight 错误须 doctor 可诊断。
feature_release_facing.assertion: scripted E2E：utterance → review → truth frozen fixture → implement → import → qa → release invoke；release verdict 来自 beacon fixture 非 loop。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **真项目 drill E2E**：greenfield + utterance（gum choose/filter）经 beacon-run：≥1 agent iteration on truth、≥1 commit on generate、qa invoke；verdict 仅 Beacon evaluator。
feature_release_facing.assertion: 规则 `ambiguous=true` 时写 `intent-tiebreak.json` 且 `delivery-state` 进入 `truth_gap_scan`（非 `user_decision_pending`）；默认 mode 无 `--strict-interrupt`。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **Requirement clarity domain vocabulary**：`requirement_clarity` 的 `inline_marker`（TBD/TODO/??? 等）须用词界或上下文过滤，**不得**因 feature slug、路径、`canonical_refs` 行、frontmatter 中的合法领域词（如 `go-todo-crud-smoke`）误 block `freeze`；须含回归 fixture：`go-todo-crud-smoke` 材料完整时 clarity gate PASS。
feature_release_facing.assertion: review runtime parallel 模式；`review-artifact.json` 含 per-lane refs。

feature_release_facing.ac_theme: **Phase promotion visibility**：harness exit 失败时 `beacon-phase.json` 须区分 `phases_completed`（agent 迭代完成）与 `phase_promoted`（harness 放行）；TUI / `gnhf.log` 须输出结构化 `harness_exit_failed`（含 `reason_code`、command、exit_code）。
feature_release_facing.assertion: P1 finding 默认 continue；`recommended_route` 驱动下一状态；无 AskUser subprocess。
agent surface / using-beacon 含 `beacon-loop goal` launch、steer、hard stop；无 subprocess skill load 要求。
`implement_loop` subprocess 为 `beacon implement run … --runner`；grep/ shim 证明无裸 `codex exec` bypass。
run 目录存在 `output-schema.json`；adapter 传 `--output-schema`；invalid JSON → iteration failure。
prompt 含 notes 只读、no-op=false、禁 agent commit；结构对齐 gnhf template 必填节。
no-op iteration 后 `delivery-state` 不得进入 `qa_pending`；含 `implement_no_op_blocked`。
各 delivery stage 映射 harness worker；`truth-promotion.json` 记录 command + runner id。
`repair_from_qa` 回灌使用同一 implement runner 路径。
AC-044 接入后 parent orchestrator 测试仍 pass（caps/stop/notes/no-op）。
真 implement runner 路径；worktree ≥1 commit 后才 `qa_pending`（可 CI opt-in）。
doctor 报告 implement runner / codex / schema 分桶与 repair route。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "orchestrator"
feature_release_facing.assertion: `packages/beacon-run` 自 gnhf fork；`createAgent` 支持 codex/claude/opencode；CLI `beacon-run run` 存在。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "beacon-phase-prompt"
feature_release_facing.assertion: iteration prompt 含 Beacon phase、skill boundary digest、`beacon-phase.json` 落盘；无 subprocess Skill MD。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "truth-phase-agent"
feature_release_facing.assertion: truth phase 使用 agent adapter（非仅 harness 模板）；mock agent 记录 phase=truth。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "no-default-template-truth"
feature_release_facing.assertion: 默认配置不调用 `prd-bootstrap`；仅 `--truth-bootstrap=fallback` 启用模板链。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "harness-checkpoint"
feature_release_facing.assertion: 迭代间 harness 调用写入 `truth-promotion.json`（phase、command、exit_code）。
冻结的 `packages/beacon-loop` 参考实现测试仍 pass；新 AC 实现于 `beacon-run`。
CLI 暴露 `--output-schema`；与 beacon-run adapter 契约一致。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && BEACON_RUN_E2E_DRILL=1 pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "e2e-gum-drill"
feature_release_facing.assertion: drill repo utterance：truth agent iteration + ≥1 commit + qa invoke；verdict 来自 beacon。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "worktree-harness-project-root"
feature_release_facing.assertion: `--worktree --beacon` 时 truth exit harness command cwd/`--project-root` = worktree；`truth-promotion.json` 不含主仓 path（mock spawn）。
clarity gate 不因 slug/path 中 todo 误 block；`beacon freeze go-todo-crud-smoke` 在材料 merge 后 PASS。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "smoke-truth-exit"
feature_release_facing.assertion: target feature `scope_mode=smoke` 时 truth exit 不调用 `sync-materials`；resolve + truth.md → advance `generate`。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "phase-promotion-visibility"
feature_release_facing.assertion: harness exit fail 时 `beacon-phase.json` 含 `phase_promoted` false + reason；不 silent 留 `phase=truth`。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "truth-freeze-gate"
feature_release_facing.assertion: draft truth 时 truth exit / generate entry **不得** promote 到 generate；freeze PASS 后 promote；`revision_not_frozen` 触发 demote/repair route。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "generate-blocked-without-frozen"
feature_release_facing.assertion: `isFeatureTruthFrozen===false` 时 generate phase **不得** `run_agent` 写产品代码。

feature_release_facing.command: cd packages/beacon-run && pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run -t "implement-preflight-demote"
feature_release_facing.assertion: `revision_not_frozen` / `legacy_cutover_required` 不空烧 cap；phase demote + truth-promotion 记录 cutover。
smoke 交付物可构建可测；完整 agent goal 路径为 CI opt-in（`BEACON_RUN_E2E_GO_TODO=1`），**须 truth frozen 后进 generate**。
